system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: A ruler measuring the length of a pipe]

What is the length of the pipe being measured?

Figure, described in words:
A horizontal ruler labeled "Meters (m)" at the top has major tick marks from 0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, with minor tick marks halfway between each major tick mark (representing increments of 0.05). Below the ruler, a gray cylindrical pipe is positioned horizontally. Dimension lines with arrows indicate the length being measured from the left end of the pipe, which aligns with 0 on the ruler, to the right end of the pipe, which aligns with the tick mark halfway between 0.8 and 0.9.

A. 0.085 m
B. 0.805 m
C. 0.85 m
D. 8.5 m

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer
